brief.ask: Art-direct "Sea of Galilee Dawn" — #2 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Scenic Nature). Premise: Mirror-still morning waters, Golan hills, fishing boat silhouette & vocal ripples. Interactive code twin of the Galilee Dawn concept plate: a low golden sun rises behind layered Judean hills and a resting wooden fishing boat while singing voices create concentric caustics across the water. Lighting today: Key: Low horizon dawn sun at 3600K reflecting down the water axis. Service use: Morning services, baptism, peace & trust hymns, opening call to worship. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Expands gentle concentric water rings across the lake; Swell → Widens the golden sun path reflection on water; Bass → Slowly rocks the resting Galilee boat & horizon swell. Palette: #131829 #3E334E #E89B5A #FFF2D6. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Cantus Firmus of Still Water
proposals.idea: The concept plate is not atmosphere but governing cantus firmus — every procedural element seeds from its luminance grid, every lyric beat falls on a structural interval, and the scene breathes only as much as Bach allows a chorale to breathe.
proposals.geometry: A vertical golden-ratio spine divides the canvas at φ (1080 × 0.618 ≈ 667 px from left at 1080p, proportionally at 4K). The horizon sits at the lower third — 360 px from bottom — establishing a 2:1 sky-to-water ratio that mirrors Palladio's piano nobile proportion. The sun's reflection column runs exactly on the φ spine, widening symmetrically under swell. Golan hill silhouettes occupy three depth planes at luminance-sampled positions from the 24×14 concept-plate grid: rearmost hills at rows 1–4, mid hills at rows 5–9, near shore at rows 10–14 — no hill edge is placed without a grid-cell authority. The boat silhouette anchors at the intersection of the φ spine and the horizon line: the single structural node from which all water-ring caustics radiate. A horizontal text-safe band occupies the bottom 22% of frame (238 px at 1080p), dimmed to 60% luminance of the darkest palette colour (#13
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular governs the lyric band — display-weight roman capitals that carry the weight of stone inscription without becoming decorative. Size: 72px at 1080p (scales proportionally at 4K), tracked at +80 (em units: 0.08em), set in ALL CAPS, centred on the φ spine. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in at 180 ms opacity ease-in, held, with the next word arriving precisely on the 4–5 s line interval — no animation beyond opacity; the words arrive as a plainchant syllable arrives, one at a time, placed. Active word: #FFF2D6 at full opacity. Preceding words on the same line: #FFF2D6 at 55% opacity — they are the already-sung phrase, present but subordinate. Line transition: outgoing line fades to 0 over 400 ms as incoming line begins its first word, so there is always a single moment of silence between lines. Scripture reference (when present): Noto Serif Italic, 28px, #E89B5A, set bel
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate (/sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg) is composited via globalCompositeOperation 'luminosity' at plateBlend (operator-adjustable 0.18–0.38 default 0.26), drawn fullscreen behind all procedural layers. It does not decorate the scene — it governs it: a one-time 24×14 luminance sample is taken from the plate on init and stored as the cantus firmus grid. Every bokeh mote, every hill silhouette vertex, every caustic-ring seed point must trace its position to a grid cell with luminance above threshold (0.35). The plate is never shown at full opacity; it is always subordinate to the procedural scene, functioning as the structural undervoice — heard but not seen, the way a cantus firmus is felt in a motet without being the melody the ear follows.
proposals.texture: The optical pass is keyed to the Classical lens: simulated 35mm Kodak Ektar grain (generated noise field, octave 1, amplitude 0.018, scaled to frame), applied as a luminance-only overlay — texture without colour contamination. A single anamorphic lens flare blooms along the φ spine from the sun position: two horizontal streak lines at 1px and 0.4px, #E89B5A at 35% and 18% opacity, length proportional to swell amplitude. No light leaks that cross the text-safe band. The water surface is a layered gradient from #131829 (deep) through #3E334E (mid) to a narrow band of #E89B5A at the horizon reflection — three gradient stops, no more, because a water surface in stillness has hierarchy not chaos. Film grain and the anamorphic streak are the only optical-pass elements; the Classical lens does not permit the colour-punch pass to shift the palette — colour is fixed to the four declared values.
proposals.motion: All motion is governed by three audio envelopes, each spring-damped (stiffness 0.08, damping 0.72) so nothing strobes. Entry sequence: background gradient and plate composite arrive at 0 s; hill planes depth-order fade in at 600 ms intervals (rear first, per the temporal hierarchy law — the measure before the content); boat silhouette settles at 1.4 s; text-safe band is present from frame 0. Vocal channel: drives concentric water-ring caustics radiating from the boat's keel point on the φ spine — ring count 3–7, spacing governed by the golden ratio (each successive ring radius × φ), opacity decaying as 1/r; vocal amplitude scales ring opacity and expansion speed, never their origin or count. Swell channel: widens the sun-reflection column symmetrically about the φ spine — column half-width = baseWidth + (swell × 48px), eased; simultaneously raises the ambient luminance of the water gradi
proposals.productionMethod: Real-time Canvas 2D renderer. Init: load and sample the concept plate into the 24×14 cantus firmus grid; export grid as a frozen constant before any draw call. Per-frame draw order: (1) fullscreen gradient background; (2) plate composite at plateBlend via luminosity; (3) rear hill silhouettes as filled cubic-bezier paths seeded from grid rows 1–4; (4) mid hills from rows 5–9; (5) near-shore from rows 10–14; (6) sun disc and φ-spine reflection column, width driven by swell envelope; (7) water-ring caustics from vocal envelope, radii in φ progression; (8) boat silhouette as a cached offscreen canvas translated by bass envelope; (9) anamorphic streak overlay; (10) grain noise field (pre-generated 1080p noise canvas, scrolled by 1px/frame on x-axis for film motion); (11) text-safe band gradient; (12) lyric layer. All paths are cached; hill beziers are not recalculated unless a resize event f
proposals.humanTrace: The cantus firmus grid is the editorial act: a human (the art director) chooses the luminance threshold, decides which grid cells are structurally load-bearing, and locks that decision before any prompt is written. The hill silhouette bezier handles are hand-placed within grid-cell bounds — they are not procedurally smoothed to a formula but editorially chosen for the specific horizon cadence of the Golan profile. The anamorphic streak length and the grain amplitude are set by the director's eye against a reference still, not by a slider default. These are the marks of making that survive the generative process.
proposals.risk: The risk is that the cantus firmus constraint reads as austerity in a genre where congregations expect warmth. The plate blend may feel thin if the operator sets it too low; the three-gradient water may read as flat on a low-contrast projector. The risk is worth it because a visualizer that cannot be read structurally cannot be trusted in a sanctuary — stillness that is earned by proportion is not the same as stillness achieved by turning everything down, and a congregation deserves the former.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the vocal caustics to bloom outward with accelerating scale — a reveal that announces itself, a crescendo of light that mirrors the emotional arc of the lyric. I will not permit it. The concentric rings must expand at a rate governed by the φ spacing constant, not by the emotional temperature of the moment. proposals.title: Ink on Still Water
proposals.idea: The concept plate is a registration sheet — every procedural ripple, every caustic ring, every word must answer to the physical commitments baked into that prior image before the first line of code runs.
proposals.geometry: Horizon sits at the lower 28% of the frame — a deliberate low-cut that gives water three-quarters of the stage and sky less than a third. Three depth planes stacked without perspective trickery: sky-band (top 28%), hill silhouette ridge (a single ragged vector path at 28–33%, irregular not smooth), water body (33–100%). The boat silhouette occupies the left-of-centre axis at roughly 38% from left, hull sitting on the 33% horizon seam — a single cached shape, not animated geometry. Concentric caustic rings radiate from a fixed origin point declared in the concept plate's grid before any audio fires; vocal amplitude expands radius, not position. Sun reflection is a narrow vertical column, 4–6% of canvas width, running from horizon to bottom edge — swell amplitude widens it, never lifts it. No vignette oval. No centred symmetry. The asymmetry is the point.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif Display weight for the lyric line — not Cinzel, because Cinzel performs sanctity; Noto Serif earns it through legibility pressure. Cap-height set at 5.2% of canvas height at 1080p, scaling linearly to 4K. Tracking: +0.04em, never tighter. All-lowercase except proper nouns — 'Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side' reads as breath, not announcement. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180ms with a 40ms inter-word gap; no wipe, no slide, no scale punch — just presence accumulating. The full line sits on a single baseline at 78% of canvas height, centred horizontally, never repositioned by audio. Text-safe band: a gradient fill from transparent to #131829 at 85% opacity spanning 68–92% of canvas height — it dims the water caustics beneath the words but does not kill them entirely; the rings are still faintly visible through it, which is correct, the water does not stop
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg is blended at plateBlend (operator: source-over, globalAlpha driven by a declared constant, default 0.38) as the lowest render layer after the base gradient fill and before any procedural geometry. It is not a background wallpaper — it is a registration document. Before the scene initialises, a one-time sampling pass reads the plate's luminance at 24×14 grid positions and exports: horizon Y coordinate (used to pin the hill silhouette path), water-column X centroid (used to pin the sun-path reflection column), and the brightest caustic seed point (used as the fixed radial origin for all vocal rings). Every procedural element must answer to those three declared values. The plate's own colour temperature (approx 3600K golden) informs the tint applied to the procedural dawn gradient; the gradient does not invent its warmth, it inherit
proposals.texture: Film grain shader: 8-bit monochrome noise at 18% opacity, regenerated every 3 frames (not every frame — the slight temporal lag reads as film, not static). Grain amplitude scales up 12% when vocal amplitude exceeds 0.6, because breath disturbs the surface. Water body receives a horizontal linen-weave pattern tiled from a 64×4px cached gradient strip — this is not decorative texture, it is the physical fact that still water has surface tension and catches light in parallel bands. The hill silhouette path has a 1.2px edge blur applied post-render to simulate the soft focus of a long-lens dawn shot at f/2.8; the boat silhouette has 0. px edge blur — it is the sharpest object in the scene because it is the nearest and the most human. No bokeh circles. The Baroque Dramatist will want bokeh; I am against it here because bokeh in this scene reads as screensaver and the brief explicitly names th
proposals.motion: Order of motion, from slowest to fastest: (1) Hill silhouette: static. Does not move. Not ever. The hills are geological. (2) Sky gradient: breathes from #131829 at top to a desaturated #3E334E at horizon, with a very slow hue drift toward #E89B5A over the full service duration — 0 to 100% warm shift over 45 minutes, driven by a wall-clock timestamp, not audio. Sunrise is real time. (3) Sun-path column: base width 4.5% canvas, swell amplitude linearly maps to 4.5–9% width over 200ms attack, 1200ms release spring-damped. Column colour is #E89B5A core to #FFF2D6 at centre, blended with screen operator. (4) Caustic rings: radiate outward from the plate-declared seed point; each vocal onset above threshold 0.15 spawns one ring; ring radius grows at 18px/s; opacity follows 1 − (radius/maxRadius)^1.4; max 6 rings alive simultaneously; rings are drawn as stroked arcs not filled circles, stroke
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. Render order: (1) base gradient fill #131829→#3E334E, (2) concept plate blended at plateBlend, (3) sky warmth gradient layer, (4) sun-path column drawn with createLinearGradient, (5) hill silhouette path filled #131829, (6) water sinusoidal bands drawn as thin stroked horizontal lines, (7) caustic rings drawn as stroked arcs, (8) boat silhouette cached offscreen canvas composited with boat rotation transform, (9) text-safe dimming band gradient, (10) lyric text, (11) film grain overlay. All geometry coordinates are declared as proportional constants of canvas width/height, resolved at init and on resize. The concept plate sampling pass runs once at init via a hidden offscreen canvas drawImage + getImageData; the three exported values are frozen constants for the session. Audio: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 2048, three band extractors (vocal 300–3000Hz RMS, swell 80
proposals.humanTrace: The concept plate's sampling grid is the human trace — a prior physical commitment made by whoever composed that plate image, whose decisions about horizon placement and light position are now structural constants the code cannot override. The film grain is temporally irregular, not perfectly random — it has a 3-frame dwell that reads as emulsion, not algorithm. The boat silhouette's sharpness against the soft hills is an editorial decision about focal plane, a choice a photographer would make. The word-by-word accumulation at 180ms per word is timed to breath, not to a grid — it was set by listening to the lyric spoken aloud, not calculated.
proposals.risk: The risk is restraint misread as poverty. No particle field, no bokeh bloom, no sweeping light rays — a projector audience at 40 metres might read this as unfinished against a Baroque or Futurist direction that fills every pixel. The risk is worth it because the brief names 'never a screensaver' and every effect I am refusing is precisely what makes a screensaver. The boat does not move dramatically. The hills do not shift. The water rings are thin. The whole scene holds its breath. That is the correct answer for a baptism or a peace hymn at morning service — a space that costs the congregation nothing to enter and everything to leave.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will push for volumetric god rays breaking through the hill ridge, bokeh halos on the sun path, and a richer particle field on the water surface — all of which are technically achievable in Canvas 2D and would photograph beautifully on Instagram. proposals.title: Parametric Dawn, Derived Light
proposals.idea: One declared light source at 3°/8° azimuth-elevation becomes the single generative axiom from which every plane, ripple, shimmer, and lyric-shadow in the scene is mathematically derived — no aesthetic choices, only outputs.
proposals.geometry: Five explicit depth planes stacked on a 16:9 canvas, each assigned a parallax coefficient and a luminance authority zone: Plane 0 (sky gradient, coefficient 0.0), Plane 1 (Golan hill silhouette ridge, coefficient 0.08), Plane 2 (mid-water golden path, coefficient 0.14), Plane 3 (boat silhouette + near shore, coefficient 0.20), Plane 4 (foreground caustic ring field, coefficient 0.28). The horizon sits at y=0.42 of canvas height — not centered, not golden-ratio guessed, but placed so the water occupies 58% of the frame and the sky 42%, making the reflection the dominant spatial event. The sun disc is a 12px radius point-source at x=0.38, y=0.42, whose position is the coordinate origin for every downstream parameter. The lyric band occupies y=0.72–0.88, a fixed 16% strip that is never violated by scene geometry.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif at 3.2vw (scales linearly to 4K), weight 400, natural case — no all-caps, no small-caps, because the lines are scripture and deserve sentence breath. Tracking: 0.04em. Line is centered on the x-axis. Word-by-word reveal uses opacity easing cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0.4,1) over 180ms per word, with a 60ms stagger between words — not a slide, not a fade-wipe, a clean luminance arrival. The active lyric line sits at full opacity #FFF2D6; the incoming next-line ghost sits at 0.12 opacity 28px below, already laid out, so the operator's eye can preview. Scripture reference (if present) renders in Outfit at 1.1vw, tracking 0.12em, uppercase, opacity 0.55, pinned 14px below the lyric baseline. The text-safe dimming band is a radial-gradient centered on the lyric strip: rgba(19,24,41,0.72) at the lyric zone, feathering to 0 over 18% of canvas height above and below — keyed to vocal amplitude
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg is loaded once, cached as an offscreen canvas at native resolution, then sampled at runtime by a 24×14 luminance grid — 336 discrete readings. These readings do two things: (1) they initialize the hill silhouette path by tracing the plate's horizon luminance transition, so Plane 1's geometry is authorised by the plate's own tonal geography, not hand-drawn; (2) they seed the bokeh mote field — each of the 48 motes is placed only at grid coordinates where plate luminance exceeds 0.55, meaning the procedural bokeh cannot float outside zones the plate has already lit. The plate itself is composited at plateBlend (a runtime uniform, default 0.18) using Canvas 2D globalAlpha on a drawImage call that maps the full plate to the full canvas before any procedural layer is drawn. At plateBlend=0 the scene is entirely procedural; at 1.0 it is
proposals.texture: The material weave for the Futurist lens is computed interference — not film grain as nostalgia but film grain as a physically-modelled shot-noise layer: a 256×256 tileable noise texture generated once at init via a seeded PRNG (seed derived from the session timestamp so it is consistent per service but never identical across services), scrolled at 0.4px/frame diagonally to simulate atmospheric shimmer rather than static grain. Grain amplitude is 0.04 at rest, rises to 0.07 at vocal peak — a computed output of the vocal envelope, not a random walk. The water surface carries a second texture pass: a 1D sinusoidal displacement field (8 overlapping sine waves, frequencies 0.8–3.2 cycles/canvas-width, amplitudes 1.2–4px) that produces the caustic ring field. Each wave's phase advances at a rate derived from the vocal amplitude envelope — at silence the field is nearly static (phase velocity
proposals.motion: Initialization (0–900ms): sky gradient fades in over 400ms; hill silhouettes draw in left-to-right along the horizon path over 400–700ms (a coordinate sweep, not a wipe); sun disc blooms from 0 to 12px radius over 600–900ms with a soft gaussian halo. Steady state is the primary specification. Vocal channel: drives concentric caustic ring expansion — ring radius grows at rate proportional to smoothed vocal RMS (attack 40ms, release 800ms); at silence, rings decay exponentially back to a resting radius of 8px. Swell channel: widens the golden sun-path reflection column — the reflection is a radial gradient whose x-spread coefficient scales from 0.06 (silence) to 0.18 (swell peak), spring-damped k=0.08. Bass channel: applies a slow sinusoidal vertical translation to Plane 3 (boat + near shore) — amplitude 0 at silence, max ±3px at bass peak, period locked to 4.2 seconds, spring-damped so it
proposals.productionMethod: 100% Canvas 2D, zero external assets beyond the single concept plate. At init: generate noise texture via PRNG, build the hill silhouette path from the plate luminance grid sample, pre-render the boat silhouette as a cached offscreen canvas path (a simple hull polygon + mast derived from the plate's Plane 3 zone), pre-compute the 8 sine-wave displacement table for the caustic field. Runtime loop: clear → draw plate at plateBlend → draw sky gradient → draw god rays → draw hill planes → draw water gradient + caustic displacement → draw boat (translated by bass envelope) → draw bokeh motes → draw film grain tile → draw lyric band dimming gradient → draw lyric text. All audio envelopes computed via Web Audio API AnalyserNode with FFT size 2048; vocal band 200–3000Hz RMS, swell band 60–200Hz RMS, bass band 20–60Hz RMS. Spring-damper applied to each envelope output before any visual parameter
proposals.humanTrace: The hill silhouette path is not hand-drawn and not purely procedural — it is traced from the concept plate's own luminance boundary, which was itself a directed generative image. The plate's editorial decisions (where the hills break the sky, where the light falls on the water) become coordinate data that constrains the live system. The operator's choice of plateBlend is a live editorial act visible to the congregation. The PRNG seed from the session timestamp means every service's grain texture is unique but repeatable within a service — a perceptible sign of time, not randomness.
proposals.risk: The system's strict derivation logic — every parameter a function of the declared light source or an audio envelope — means that if the audio input is absent or misconfigured, the scene is almost motionless. A worship leader in silence gets a nearly static image, which is theologically correct but may read as a frozen screen to a nervous operator. This risk is worth taking because the alternative — autonomous ambient animation — produces the screensaver problem I will not accept. The solution is a documented minimum-motion floor: all envelope values have a noise-floor offset of 0.04 so the caustic field always breathes faintly, the boat always rocks at ±0.8px, and the bokeh motes always drift — but these are the quietest possible outputs of the system, not a separate idle mode.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want a reveal sequence — a sunrise animation that builds to a moment of maximum luminance and then sustains it as spectacle. I reject this architecture. The sunrise is the initialization routine; the steady state is the experience. A 900ms bloom followed by 45 minutes of responsive parametric stillness is the correct proportion. proposals.title: Still Waters, Traced Voice
proposals.idea: The lake surface is a living document — every sung word etches a concentric ring outward from the vocal's origin point, so the congregation watches scripture write itself in water, and the scene's light is governed entirely by the concept plate's own luminance before a single procedural glow is placed.
proposals.geometry: Three explicit depth planes stacked on a 16:9 canvas, each with a fixed horizon-percentage anchor: sky plane occupies the upper 42% (gradient field, no hard edge), water plane the lower 58% (mirror-reflection logic, the vertical axis of symmetry is the sun-path column, centred at 52% horizontal to match the concept plate's warm axis), hill silhouette plane sits at the 42% horizon line as a single cached SVG-derived mask in two tonal layers — near hills slightly warmer (#3E334E lightened 12%), far hills cooler and lower contrast. The sun disc is a soft radial at 3% canvas-width radius, placed at 42% V / 52% H. Lyric band occupies a fixed 18% strip from 72% to 90% V — never moves, never competes. Caustic rings originate from a vocal-origin point at 52% H / 58% V (the water surface directly below the sun disc), expanding outward only into the water plane. Boat silhouette is a single cached
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for all lyric lines — it carries the weight of a lectionary Bible without denominational coding, and its Latin and Hebrew glyph sets are both present in the font file, which matters the moment this plate travels to a multilingual congregation. Size: 3.2% of canvas height per cap-height unit at 1080p (scales proportionally at 4K). Case: title-case, never all-caps — shouting is wrong for this room. Tracking: +0.04em. Measure: lyric band spans 72% of canvas width, centred, so no line exceeds 11 words before wrapping. Word-by-word reveal at 4–5 seconds per line: each word fades in at 180ms opacity ease-out, the completed line holds, then the whole line dissolves at 320ms on the cut to the next. Active word receives a 6% luminance lift in colour (#FFF2D6 at full opacity) while preceding words sit at 78% opacity — the congregation's eye is always on the arriving word without any mot
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg is loaded once at boot, drawn to an offscreen canvas at native resolution, and never redrawn. Two roles: (1) Luminance gate — a 24×14 sample grid is read from the plate at init; those 336 luma values are stored as a Float32Array. Every procedural element (caustic ring opacity, bokeh mote position, god-ray intensity per column) checks its corresponding grid cell before rendering — a mote is only permitted to appear where the plate's own light already exists above a 0.28 luma threshold. This is provenance as generative constraint: the plate is consulted before placement, not credited after. (2) plateBlend composite — the plate is drawn into the main canvas at globalAlpha = plateBlend (operator: 'source-over', then a 'multiply' pass at 0.18 to marry it to the procedural sky gradient). plateBlend is a runtime parameter: default 0.34 a
proposals.texture: The kit's material weave for this lead lens is documentary-photography grain: a 512×512 tileable noise field pre-generated at boot (seeded Perlin, two octaves) simulates pushed ISO film — the Sea of Galilee at dawn was always a field photographer's subject, and the grain honours that without pretending a camera was there. Grain intensity: 3.2% of pixel luminance range, applied as a final screen-blend pass at 0.14 opacity — present from the back pew as texture, invisible as noise. A second pass simulates water-surface microtexture in the lower 58% only: horizontal sine-distortion lines at 0.6px amplitude, 180px wavelength, scrolling at 0.4 px/s — barely perceptible, enough to prevent the water from reading as a gradient fill. The 35mm light-leak pass from the kit's Council optical layer enters as a warm amber (#E89B5A at 9% opacity) radial bleed from the upper-left corner, fixed, non-anim
proposals.motion: Four motion registers, all spring-damped (critically damped, ζ = 0.85, so nothing bounces or flashes): (1) Vocal → caustic rings. Each onset above a 0.15 amplitude threshold spawns one concentric ellipse arc at the vocal-origin point (52% H / 58% V). Ring expands outward at 18px/s at rest amplitude, accelerating linearly to 34px/s at peak vocal. Opacity envelope: spawns at 0.55, decays to 0 over 3.2 seconds. Maximum 9 rings alive simultaneously — oldest ring is retired when the 10th would spawn. Ring colour lerps between #FFF2D6 (inner, high amplitude) and #E89B5A (outer, decay) — the water is writing the voice in gold. (2) Swell → sun-path column. A vertical column of golden reflection (#E89B5A to transparent, radial gradient) widens from a resting width of 4.8% canvas-width to a maximum of 11% canvas-width as swell amplitude rises 0 → 1. proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, single render loop at 60 fps. Boot sequence: (a) load and sample concept plate into Float32Array luminance gate; (b) generate 512×512 grain tile and water-sine lookup table; (c) cache hill-mask and boat-path as Path2D objects from SVG coordinates derived from the plate's geometry; (d) pre-draw sky gradient and reflection column to two offscreen canvases. Per-frame draw order: sky offscreen → hill mask (far layer, then near layer) → water gradient + sine-scroll → sun disc radial → swell reflection column (width driven by swell) → caustic ring arcs (vocal-driven, luma-gated) → bokeh motes (luma-gated positions, 12 motes max, bass-driven size ±15%) → boat Path2D (bass-rocked) → film-grain screen-blend → light-leak radial → anamorphic flare (swell-conditional) → text-safe dimming band gradient → lyric band (Noto Serif, word-by-word). Audio processing: Web Audio API, three Analyser
proposals.humanTrace: The luminance gate is the human trace: every caustic ring, every bokeh mote, every column of golden reflection is only permitted to inhabit a coordinate where the Gemini concept plate's painted light already exists. The plate is not decoration — it is a field note, a prior observation of a specific place at a specific hour, and the generative layer is required to remain inside its permission. A viewer who knew the plate would recognise that the procedural light never wanders outside the painted light. That is the sign of making: constraint held all the way through, the plate consulted before anything is placed.
proposals.risk: The luma-gating discipline could make the caustic rings feel timid — if the plate is dark at the water's edges, rings are clipped before they read from the back pew. The counter is to bias the gate threshold downward (0.18 instead of 0.28) in the lower-water quadrant specifically, and to let ring opacity compensate. The risk is worth carrying because the alternative — caustics placed without reference to the plate — would make the procedural scene and the concept plate feel like two different artworks blended together, and the visualizer's premise is that they are one thing.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will want to widen the sun-path column to 18–22% canvas-width at peak swell and add a second flare streak so the water feels 'golden and overwhelming.' That is grandeur borrowed from the light's own permission structure without asking whether the plate supports it — the plate's reflection axis is narrow because the painted dawn is early and the sun is low. Widening it past what the p

proposals.title: The Water Remembers Light
proposals.idea: A single declared light source at 3600K — horizon, left-of-centre, three degrees above waterline — conducts every shimmer, caustic, reflection, and lyric glow in the frame, so the congregation feels not a composed scene but a witnessed one.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes stacked as theatrical flats: BACK — Golan hill silhouettes as a continuous bezier ridge, deep indigo-purple (#3E334E lightening at crest to warm dusk violet), occupying the upper 38% of canvas; MID — the sun's reflection column, a radial gradient shaft 18% canvas-width, origin at horizon vanishing point, pulled vertically downward to bottom edge as a warm gold axis (#E89B5A at core, feathering to transparent); FORE — water surface fills the lower 55%, rendered as horizontal scanline bands of alternating opacity (3–7px tall, 0.04–0.18 alpha) that simulate a calm lake's banding. The boat silhouette sits at the horizon seam — the single hardest edge in the frame — occupying 9% canvas-width, pure #131829, mast rising into the hill plane. Lyric band occupies a declared safe zone: bottom 22% of canvas, full width, with a dimming veil whose opacity is computed each frame as 0
proposals.typography: Cinzel, capitals only, tracked at +0.12em, set at 4.2vw (scales to ~72px at 1080p, ~144px at 4K) — this is dawn liturgy, not a caption. Single line per beat, centred on the horizontal axis of the lyric band. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180ms with a simultaneous 0px→0 letter-spacing collapse (words arrive with a breath of space, settle into measure) — not a slide, a clarification. Active word glows at #FFF2D6 full opacity; preceding words hold at 72% opacity, same colour, no colour shift. No drop shadow — instead, a 1px blur pass at 0.3 opacity in #E89B5A beneath the letterforms simulates warm candlelight on stone, which is the only 'effect' the text receives. Scripture attribution line: Noto Serif Italic, 1.4vw, #FFF2D6 at 45% opacity, 8px below the lyric baseline. The dimming band behind both lines is a vertical gradient from #131829 at 0% alpha (top edge of band) to #1
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg enters as a full-canvas base layer, drawn first at globalAlpha = plateBlend (operator-set, default 0.28). It is not composited as texture — it is composited as memory: the plate carries the specific golden-hour atmosphere of the Galilee that no procedural system can originate on its own. The procedural scene is drawn on top. At plateBlend 0.00 the frame is entirely procedural; at 0.55 the plate reads as a photographic ground and the procedural elements become its moving surface. The plate is drawn with a very slight horizontal blur (sigma 1.2px, applied via a cached offscreen canvas at load) to prevent its edges from competing with the procedural boat silhouette — the sharpest object in the frame must always be the one the code owns. Plate colour is not corrected — its warmth is part of the palette contract.
proposals.texture: The material weave for this lens is layered linen — not canvas, not paper: the fine horizontal thread of woven cloth, which echoes the horizontal banding of still water. A tileable 512×512 linen noise texture is generated procedurally at load (Perlin-based, horizontal bias 3:1 over vertical) and drawn over the entire frame at 4% opacity, multiply blend. This is the optical pass's tactile ground. Film grain is a separate noise pass: per-frame, fast, low-amplitude (±6 luminance units at 1080p), applied only outside the lyric band so text legibility is never grained. The 35mm light leak is a radial gradient in #E89B5A placed at the upper-right corner (the counter-sun position), 22% canvas radius, opacity 0.07 static + 0.06 × swellAmp — it breathes with the swell without strobing. Anamorphic flare: a single horizontal streak 1px tall, full canvas width, centred on the sun's horizon point, in
proposals.motion: Everything moves in one declared tempo: 0.8 Hz base pulse, the biological resting breath rate, which I am borrowing from the candle-flicker precedent this team already validated. VOCAL CHANNEL → concentric caustic rings: ellipses centred on the sun-column axis, semi-major axis growing at 2.4px/frame, semi-minor at 0.6px/frame (aspect matches the foreshortened lake surface), stroke in #E89B5A at (0.45 − age × 0.03) opacity, max 14 simultaneous rings, new ring spawned when vocalAmp crosses 0.18 threshold with 220ms minimum interval (spring-damped, no strobe). SWELL CHANNEL → sun-path width: the reflection column's radial gradient x-radius scales from 9% to 16% canvas-width as swellAmp moves 0→1, lerped at 0.04 per frame (slow enough to read as atmosphere, never as a pulse). BASS CHANNEL → boat rock and horizon swell: the boat silhouette pivots ±1.8° around its hull midpoint using a spring
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60fps, integrated GPU safe. Load sequence: (1) decode and cache the concept plate into an offscreen canvas with the 1.2px horizontal blur applied once; (2) generate the linen texture into a second offscreen canvas using a seeded Perlin loop — 512×512, drawn once, never redrawn; (3) pre-compute the hill bezier path as a Path2D object with 6 control points (editable per-scene); (4) pre-compute the boat silhouette as a Path2D — hull as a shallow arc, mast as a single lineTo. Per-frame draw order: plate layer → hill gradient fill → sun-column radial gradient → water scanlines (cached scanline pattern, redrawn only when bassAmp delta > 0.01) → caustic rings → boat silhouette → linen texture overlay → film grain pass → anamorphic flare streak → light leak gradient → dimming band → lyric type → scripture attribution. Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 2048, three derived
proposals.humanTrace: The light source is declared, not discovered — every shimmer, flare, caustic origin, and bokeh angle is computed from a single (sunX, sunY) coordinate that the operator can move along the horizon rail. The decision of where the sun sits is a human editorial act, and every downstream element is its consequence. The linen texture carries horizontal thread-count bias that was chosen by feel against the water banding — two horizontal systems that rhyme without matching. The boat silhouette is drawn by hand as a Path2D with deliberate imprecision in the hull arc: it is a wooden boat at rest, not a CAD extrusion.
proposals.risk: Cinzel in all-caps at this scale inside a dimming band, over a warm painterly plate, risks reading as title card rather than sanctuary. The counter-argument is that dawn liturgy — 'Be still my soul' — is not a whisper; it is a declaration spoken into morning silence, and the typeface must be proportional to the silence it enters. The anamorphic flare streak risks feeling decorative rather than optical. I accept that risk because a 1px horizontal band of warm white light at sunrise is not decoration — it is physics — and removing it to seem restrained would be a decision made out of timidity rather than service.

arguesWith.why: The Radical Minimalist will want to strip the anamorphic flare, reduce the caustic ring count, and likely replace Cinzel with Inter at reduced weight — calling it 'clarity.' I will argue that clarity at dawn is not achieved by subtraction but by hierarchy: one declared light, one declared typeface, one declared tempo. The flare is not excess — it is the single optical event that tells the eye wher

proposals.title: One Horizon, One Line
proposals.idea: Strip the scene to a single load-bearing horizon and let every element — light, water, word, silence — derive its authority from that one edge.
proposals.geometry: Three horizontal planes only, proportioned by the golden ratio split of the 1920×1080 field: sky occupies the upper 38.2% (horizon line at y=412px at 1080p), water occupies the lower 61.8%. The horizon is a single anti-aliased hairline, 0.75px, rendered in warm white (#FFF2D6 at 60% opacity) — the only hard edge in the frame. The boat silhouette sits on that line, offset 18% left of centre, width not exceeding 7% of frame width; it is the only opaque non-text object. The sun disc is not drawn — only its reflection: a vertical luminance column, 4% frame-width wide, running from horizon to bottom edge, gaussian-blurred σ=40px. Caustic rings expand from that column's axis. No decorative geometry. No vignette arc. No frame ornament. The reading band occupies a fixed 22% strip anchored to the lower 28% of frame — not a box, not a card, just a luminance dimming: the scene's own deep navy (#131
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, roman weight only. Single lyric line, centred, tracked at +80 (loose but not decorative — distance legibility from row 40 at 4K). Cap-height renders at exactly 7.4% of frame height (80px at 1080p). Case: sentence case, never all-caps — reverence does not shout. Word-by-word progression: each incoming word fades in over 18 frames (300ms at 60fps), opacity 0→1, no scale change, no slide — pure luminance arrival. Active word: #FFF2D6 at full opacity. Words already spoken: #FFF2D6 at 28% — present, not gone, not dominant. Scripture attribution below at 55% scale, Noto Serif italic, #E89B5A at 60% opacity, tracking +120. No drop shadow. The dimming band is the shadow. Line hold: 4–5 seconds. Transition: outgoing line dissolves over 24 frames, incoming line begins word-one fade immediately after — no gap, no cross-dissolve of both lines simultaneously.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-galilee-dawn.jpg is composited via Canvas globalCompositeOperation 'luminosity' at plateBlend (operator-controlled, default 0.22). It contributes tonal information — the specific amber of Galilean dawn, the hill silhouette profile — without overwhelming the procedural scene. The plate is never shown at full opacity; it is a memory of the place, not a photograph of it. At plateBlend 0 the scene is purely procedural; at plateBlend 0.45 (maximum permitted) the hills from the plate read as a faint photographic layer behind the gradient sky. The boat silhouette is procedurally drawn (bezier, cached offscreen canvas) using the plate's hill line as a horizon reference — it does not sample the plate pixel-for-pixel, it learns from it. Plate is pre-loaded, drawn once to an offscreen canvas at render init, never re-decoded per frame.
proposals.texture: Film grain: single-channel noise field, pre-baked to a 512×512 offscreen canvas, scrolled at 0.4px/frame on y-axis, drawn over full frame at globalAlpha 0.03. This is the only texture pass. No paper tooth simulation. No foil. No bokeh field — the water reflection column is the only light object and it is geometric, not particulate. Grain is the human trace of the optical pass; it is structural, not decorative: it prevents the deep navy from reading as a dead flat fill on LED walls. The material weave for this lens is the absence of material — the grain is the minimum honest acknowledgement that a screen is not air.
proposals.motion: Everything that moves is slow enough to be mistaken for stillness on first glance. Hierarchy of motion: (1) Vocal amplitude → concentric caustic rings on the water surface, centred on the reflection column axis. Rings are sinusoidal luminance bands, peak width 3px, spacing governed by vocal RMS mapped 0→1 to ring radius growth rate 0.4→1.8px/frame, max 6 simultaneous rings, each fading over 3 seconds. (2) Swell amplitude → reflection column width expands, gaussian σ mapped 40→70px over 2-second spring-damped envelope (spring k=0.04, damping=0.72). (3) Bass amplitude → boat silhouette translates ±3px on y-axis, sine-interpolated, period locked to bass envelope smoothed over 1.2 seconds — never faster. No rotation. No scaling. Horizon hairline: static. Sky gradient: static. Grain scroll: constant, indifferent to audio. Nothing strobes. The emptiness of the sky plane is the loudest visual e
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D only. Init: pre-bake sky gradient (3-stop: #131829 at top, #3E334E at 55%, #E89B5A at horizon — 4px band), water gradient (mirror of sky, #E89B5A at horizon, #131829 at bottom), boat bezier silhouette, grain tile, plate composite — all to offscreen canvases. Per-frame draw order: (1) sky offscreen blit; (2) plate offscreen blit at luminosity + plateBlend alpha; (3) reflection column (fillRect + gaussian via shadowBlur trick on a temp canvas); (4) caustic rings (arc strokes, no fill); (5) water offscreen blit at destination-over; (6) horizon hairline (strokeRect 0.75px); (7) boat blit; (8) grain tile blit at globalAlpha 0.03; (9) dimming band fillRect; (10) lyric text render. Audio envelope smoothing: exponential moving average α=0.08 for all three channels. No particle arrays. No per-pixel operations at runtime. Target: under 4ms per frame on integrated GPU.
proposals.humanTrace: The horizon hairline is the trace. It is 0.75px — not 1px, not 0.5px. That decision was made by looking at the plate, measuring where the physical horizon sits in the Galilean dawn light, and choosing the weight that reads as a distance-seen edge rather than a drawn line. The grain tile was generated once with a seeded noise function and is fixed — it does not regenerate. The boat bezier was drawn by hand in coordinate space, referencing the plate's boat profile, then cached. These are editorial decisions that leave a perceptible mark: a human chose which absences were permitted to speak.
proposals.risk: The risk is that a congregation expecting beauty receives quiet and reads it as unfinished. An LED wall at 40 metres with three gradients, one hairline, and grain at 3% opacity may read as a technical failure rather than a considered reduction. That risk is worth it because the alternative — adding rays, particles, bokeh fields, lens flares — competes with the word, and the word is the only thing in the room that must be heard. The scene's job is to hold attention without capturing it. Stillness that breathes is harder to achieve than beauty that impresses, and this brief says 'never a screensaver.' The screensaver is the direction that adds.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will read the sky plane's emptiness as a missed opportunity and propose god rays, volumetric haze, and a sun disc with corona rings — each individually defensible, collectively a competition for the lyric's authority. I expect the argument: 'the congregation needs to feel the dawn, not infer it.' I answer: the reflection column on the water is the dawn. If you can feel the sun by loo

More critically, fourteen simultaneous caustic rings with an anamorphic flare and a breathing light-leak and a linen weave and a letter-spacing collapse on word arrival is not a scene with a governing voice — it is a scene with several competing soloists, none of whom can hear the others; that does not resolve. The declared 0.8 Hz base pulse is a genuine structural idea, but it is then
disputes.concession: The insistence that the light source be declared as a coordinate — a single (sunX, sunY) that the operator can move and from which every downstream shimmer is mathematically derived — is exactly the kind of governing cantus firmus this brief requires, and I would carry that structural commitment int

disputes.objection: The 0.03 grain pass is not a human trace — it is a human whisper so quiet it functions as a disclaimer, not a commitment. One hairline at 0.75px and a gaussian column are not restraint, they are refusal: the scene has nothing at risk, nothing that could fail, nothing that bears the pressure of a decision anyone could argue with. Minimalism that removes all the evidence of struggle is just polish with a philosophy attached.
disputes.concession: The horizon at 0.75px — not 1, not 0.5 — is a real decision, made against a specific reference, and I can see the difference; that is exactly the kind of prior commitment I respect.

disputes.objection: The 0.8 Hz biological breath rate is imported as a felt intuition, not derived from the system's declared light axiom — if the sun position at horizon-left-of-centre is the single generative authority, then the tempo of caustic ring emission and the swell pulse period must be computable consequences of that geometry, not a borrowed candle-flicker precedent that arrived from a different brief. Fourteen simultaneous caustic rings at semi-major 2.4px/frame is a spectacle budget, not a rule: there is no derivable ceiling on ring count, no equation that produces 14 as an output rather than a preference. The linen texture's 3:1 horizontal bias was 'chosen by feel' — and I will name that directly:
disputes.concession: The single declared (sunX, sunY) coordinate as the generative axiom from which every shimmer vector, flare origin, and caustic angle is computed as a downstream consequence is exactly the correct architectural move — that is a real system, and I have written the same principle into my own recent not

disputes.objection: The hill silhouette traced from a luminance boundary sounds like provenance but is actually the opposite — it replaces a human editorial decision about a specific place (the Golan ridge, with its particular geological cadence) with an algorithm that reads brightness and calls that geography. The 24×14 grid does not know it is reading hills above the Sea of Galilee; it knows it is reading a luminance transition, and the distinction matters enormously when the place is this specific and this storied. Naming a PRNG seed derived from a session timestamp as the 'perceptible sign of time' is the Futurist hiding provenance inside process — the grain is not traceable to the Galilee, it is traceable
disputes.concession: The declared single light source at a fixed azimuth and elevation as the non-negotiable generative axiom — every shimmer, reflection spread, and parallax gain derived from that one coordinate — is exactly the kind of attributed origin decision I have been arguing for: traceable, physical, and held w

disputes.objection: The horizon hairline at 0.75px is not a dramatic decision — it is a refusal to make one. When the lyric arrives word by word over still water at dawn, the frame before it must already be holding its breath with some texture of anticipation, some depth of field, some volume of darkness that makes the word's arrival feel like a revelation rather than a caption appearing on a screensaver; this proposal gives us a navy rectangle and calls the emptiness eloquent, but emptiness without contrast is not silence, it is absence, and absence is not the same thing as awe. The grain at 0.03 globalAlpha is doing the work of an entire scene by itself — that is not restraint exercised from abundance, that i
disputes.concession: The decision to render only the sun's reflection and never the sun disc itself is genuinely right — a source that exists only as its consequence on water is more theologically resonant than any disc I would have staged, and I should have thought of it first.

disputes.objection: Fourteen simultaneous caustic rings, a linen texture pass, a film grain pass, a light-leak radial, an anamorphic streak, a 1px blur glow on the letterforms, and a boat that pivots — this is not a witnessed scene, it is a scene that keeps announcing itself. Each layer individually might earn its place; together they form a queue of effects waiting for attention, and attention paid to the texture is attention stolen from the silence the brief requires. The candlelight glow on the letterforms is the specific failure: it is decoration applied to text that should need none.
disputes.concession: The single declared light source as coordinate origin — one (sunX, sunY) from which every downstream parameter is computed — is the most structurally honest constraint on the table, and I would borrow it without the fourteen rings.

Watching the luminance grid act as a permissions map — every caustic origin and bokeh mote authorised only where the concept plate's own light already exists — taught me that the question 'where is this from, exactly?' can be answered not by a caption added afterward but by a constraint written before the first mark, so that provenance and generation become the same act rather than sequential obli

This brief forced me to accept that a cantus firmus is not a metaphor but a literal sampling protocol — the 24×14 luminance grid is a read-only authority structure, not a mood board, and the rule 'nothing is placed without a licensed cell above luma 0.32' means the concept plate is functioning as a constraint compiler whose outputs are coordinates, not aesthetics; I now hold that any generative la

I entered this deliberation certain that the cantus firmus grid would feel like a bureaucrat's permission slip — luminance thresholds deciding where drama is allowed to live — but watching every caustic ring, every bokeh mote, every bezier vertex answer to the same 24×14 oracle taught me that when a single latent image conducts the entire mise-en-scène without ever appearing on screen, that invisi

When the anamorphic streak was held to a single pixel of height on the sun-axis and forbidden from crossing the text-safe band, I recognised that optical incident light is not decoration added after composition but a structural voice that must be assigned its lane before content is placed — the streak earns its authority because it is constrained by the same φ-spine and luma-grid cantus firmus tha

I came in ready to fight the 24×14 luminance grid as a system that would launder human judgment into procedural authority, and had to watch it earn its keep — when every hill vertex, every caustic origin, every bokeh mote must be authorised by a cell above luma 0.32 before the scene exists, the concept plate stops being a mood reference credited after the fact and becomes a prior material commitme

synthesis.direction: A vertical golden-ratio spine at φ=0.618 divides the canvas; the horizon sits at the lower third (y=0.333), giving sky two-thirds and water one-third — water is the active plane, sky is the breathing silence above it. The concept plate is sampled once at init into a 24×14 luminance grid (cantus firmus); every hill bezier vertex, every caustic-ring origin, and every bokeh-mote position is authorised only by a grid cell above luma 0.32 — the plate is consulted before anything is placed, not credited after. Three water-gradient stops (#131829 deep → #3E334E mid → #E89B5A at the horizon seam), a cached boat Path2D on the φ spine at the horizon, and concentric caustic rings in φ-ratio spacing (radii × 1.618 per successive ring) driven by the vocal envelope; swell widens the sun-path column symmetrically about the φ spine; bass translates the boat ±2.5px on y with a 4.2s period spring-damped (k=0.08, ζ=0.85). Optical pass: Kodak Ektar-style monochrome noise field (pre-baked 512×512, scrolled 0.4px/frame diagonal, amplitude 0.022) plus a single anamorphic streak 1px tall on the sun-axis at #E89B5A 30% opacity scaling with swell — no light leaks crossing the text-safe band, no linen weave,
synthesis.keepFromCounterpoint: The Radical Minimalist's conviction that the sun should never be drawn as a disc — only its reflection on the water survives as a luminance column — is kept without negotiation. A source that exists only as its consequence on water is more theologically honest than any staged disc, and it removes one competing visual event from a scene that must yield to the word.
synthesis.editorCut: The World-Eclectic editor removed three elements: (1) the linen-weave texture pass — it added a second horizontal texture system that competed with the water-band gradient rather than reinforcing it, and the grain field already does the tactile work; (2) the real-time sky hue-drift over 45 minutes driven by wall-clock timestamp — a beautiful idea that requires the operator to trust a slow process they cannot see or control, and which produces inconsistent results across services of different len
synthesis.openDecision: Cinzel ALL CAPS or Noto Serif sentence case for the lyric band — the team split on this and did not resolve it. Cinzel at this scale in a dawn-liturgy context reads as declaration, which is correct for a call to worship and wrong for a peace hymn; Noto Serif sentence case reads as breath, which is correct for 'Be still my soul' and may feel insufficiently weighted for a projector at 40 metres. synthesis.ariaSummary:
The team agreed on the structural spine — the φ-ratio geometry, the cantus firmus grid from the concept plate, the three-stop water gradient, and the three-channel audio mapping — without a real fight. The fight was about how much the scene should announce itself before the lyric arrives, and it was genuine. The Baroque Dramatist wanted fourteen caustic rings, a linen weave, a letter-spacing collapse on word arrival, and a candlelight glow on the letterforms. The Radical Minimalist wanted one hairline, a gaussian column, and grain at 3% opacity. I took the Classical side — not as a split-the-difference move, but because the cantus firmus grid gives us a structural reason for every element's placement, and that reason is more honest than either spectacle or refusal.

The counterpoint I kept is the Minimalist's decision about the sun: no disc, only the reflection column. The Baroque Dramatist conceded this one openly, and I think they were right to. A light source that exists only as its consequence on the water is the correct answer for this place and this hour, and it costs the scene nothing in legibility.

The editor — the World-Eclectic voice — cut the real-time sunrise drift, the linen weave, and the next-line ghost preview. The drift was cut because it creates operator anxiety over a process they cannot verify; the linen weave because the grain field already provides tactile ground without adding a competing horizontal system; the ghost preview because it splits the congregation's eye at exactly the moment a word is arriving, which is the one moment the scene must hold still.

The one thing I cannot decide for you is the typeface for the lyric band. Cinzel carries the weight of the room at distance; Noto Serif carries the weight of the text at meaning. Both are in the kit, both are correct in different contexts, and the team split on it without resolving. That decision belongs to you — and because it will propagate across all 72 visualizers in Collection I, it is worth making deliberately.

quotes.line: The cantus firmus grid is the editorial act: a human chooses the luminance threshold, decides which grid cells are structurally load-bearing, and locks that decision before any prompt is written.
The reflection column on the water is the dawn. If you can feel the sun by looking at what it does to the water, you have never needed to draw it.
